acquisition method: Data dependent acquisition consisted of full MS scans in the range of m/z 370 to 1700
cleavage agent: gel bands were excised and proteins were in-gel digested using trypsin for subsequent mass spectrometry (MS) analysis
fragmentation method: fragmentation of the 15 most abundant multiply charged precursor ions by higher energy collisional dissociation
instrument: coupled to a Q-Exactive Plus mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
labeling: MS raw data were searched using MaxQuant version 2.0.2.0 against the reference proteome protein sequences for S. denitrificans from UniProt
ptm: Carbamidomethylation of cysteine residues (fixed); oxidation of methionine (variable); acetylation of protein N termini (variable); flavin cofactors FMN and FAD at histidine (variable)

Carbamidomethylation of cysteine residues was considered as fixed modification, oxidation of methionine, acetylation of protein N termini as variable modifications. Furthermore, flavin cofactors FMN and FAD were allowed as variable modifications at histidine
